note: 795 detectors with a typical weekday, 639 of them on these roads. Each detector covers one lane. Flows are the median of each hour over the school-term Tuesdays to Thursdays of 2024-05-06 to 2024-05-31 and 2024-09-16 to 2024-09-30. A road without a detector borrows the nearest measured stretch of the same street, or the median of its road class.
